description: This file defines the EncryptedDocument class, which manages encrypted storage of documents, including encryption, decryption, metadata handling, and integrity verification using AES encryption and HMAC. It implements reading and writing encrypted data sections, metadata parsing, and ensures atomic updates on disk.

classes.name: EncryptedDocument
classes.description: Manages encrypted storage and retrieval of documents, including encryption, decryption, metadata handling, and integrity verification. Supports reading/writing encrypted sections, metadata parsing, and atomic file updates.

methods.name: EncryptedDocument
methods.description: Constructor initializing the encrypted document with given document ID, file location, and cryptographic keys.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the file object associated with this encrypted document.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the file name of the encrypted document.

methods.name: readMetadata
methods.description: Decrypts and parses the metadata section from the document, verifying document ID.

methods.name: readContent
methods.description: Decrypts and reads the content section, writing it into the provided ParcelFileDescriptor.

methods.name: writeMetadataAndContent
methods.description: Encrypts and writes metadata and content to disk atomically; reads content from a ParcelFileDescriptor.

methods.name: readSection
methods.description: Reads and decrypts a section starting at the current file offset, validating MAC.

methods.name: writeSection
methods.description: Encrypts and writes a data section from an InputStream, returning plaintext length.
